value.title: The prime's operating picture and prompts
Picture: per role in the view (JSON and human), waiting requests (s05 queue), latest output (s06), memory freshness (s07), and whether each holder's seat is live
value.notes: community/directory.rs view; one store read each (assignments, queued requests, newest output per role via a new store read, registry list once in http); memory folder read in-process.

value.title: Condition prompts (req-12) as `actions`: no live holder with requests waiting; two live holders on a one-holder role; memory not updated across the last two closes; each with its runnable command
value.notes: Mirror s05's wake commands (pij-rs revive, pij directory assign). The missing core and security roles stay in `prompts` (s03).

value.title: Needs (req-24, req-27): a not-complete roadmap step's `needs: role:<id>` with no such role prompts its creation from a template or as a new definition; a standing PEC notice to name a need no role covers
value.notes: Roadmaps read in-process from the project repo's docs/project/roadmaps/*.dd.json.

value.title: F21: the view names the project's designated prime (projects.prime_id); a missing `prime` role document's prompt says it is the role document that is missing, not the prime
F22: holder times render in local time with zone; a many-holder role renders one holder per line
value.notes: CLI render_directory; offset in-process (time local-offset), UTC when unknown.

value.title: Cost receipts: spawn sites, private-daemon spawn deltas for the view, live before reading; reads per call stated in backpressure
Docs and states: pij-rs-api.md, skill verb coverage, roadmap s09 complete, req-12 and req-24 shipped, req-27 in-progress, c-orient shipped
